prompt_text:
Continue the text below with exactly one short, natural, coherent English sentence. Return only the continuation, with no preamble or explanation:
An alien has kidnapped Matt Damon, not knowing what lengths humanity goes through to retrieve him whenever he goes missing. The star who is the most beloved celebrity in the world is disliked by no one. He recently took Tom Hank's place as the most trusted man in the world. He has save countless lives around the world with his multi billion dollar charities. The world will stop at nothing to get Matt Damon back.

Now that the aliens have Matt and have been monitoring chatter on Earth, they realize they may have made a huge mistake. The people of Earth are highly protective and overbearing when it comes to their love for Matt Damon says the one of the alien leaders. They are mobilizing as we speak to go to any lengths to save him. The humans are being watched over by a few other alien races so we need to handle this quietly or it may be the start of an intergalactic war.
reference_text: Back down on earth a plan has been put into motion to board the alien ship and rescue Matt Damon. The aliens are very well aware of the humans plan and can stop them easily but know that will lead to a much larger escalation that may draw the attention of the other races.
